facts.F1: Story #6376 S06 Connector capability interfaces, nwdes feature B of two (capabilities). Split IWorkTrackingConnector so that no connector claims a member it cannot serve: the base keeps the members all five connectors implement; IWriteBackTarget (Jira, Azure DevOps), IFeatureSource (Jira, Azure DevOps, Linear, CSV) and one IIncrementalSource (Jira, Azure DevOps) holding the Team, Portfolio and parent-Feature sweep and by-id members with the per-connection probe. Callers test the type; a missing capability ends in the same outcome as today. Each slice removes its throws and their entries from the ratchet list feature A added. Behaviour-free: same sync path per connector and connection, same validation and write-back answers, same responses. Design: docs/feature/story-6376-s06-connector-capability-interfaces/feature-delta.md (Decisions, D-1 changed to b, Slices B1-B3, Ratchet design).

Base IWorkTrackingConnector keeps SupportsTransitionHistory, GetPredefinedAdditionalFields, GetWorkItemsForTeam(team, ct), ValidateConnection, ValidateTeamSettings, ValidatePortfolioSettings (all five connectors). IWriteBackTarget: WriteFieldsToWorkItems (Jira, Azure DevOps). IFeatureSource: GetFeaturesForPortfolio(portfolio, ct), GetParentFeaturesDetails (Jira, Azure DevOps, Linear, CSV). IIncrementalSource: SupportsIncrementalSync(connection), SweepWorkItemsForTeam, GetWorkItemsForTeam(team, ids, ct), SweepFeaturesForPortfolio, GetFeaturesForPortfolio(portfolio, ids, ct), SweepParentFeatures (Jira, Azure DevOps). One file per interface in Services/Interfaces/WorkTrackingConnectors, namespace Lighthouse.Backend.Services.Interfaces.WorkTrackingConnectors. IIncrementalSource does not inherit IFeatureSource: the Portfolio refresh already holds its IFeatureSource and tests IIncrementalSource on the same connector, so no level or second capability is baked into the port Epic 6474 will make unit-generic. Markers: IJiraWorkTrackingConnector and IAzureDevOpsWorkTrackingConnector list all three; ILinearWorkTrackingConnector lists IFeatureSource; IServiceNowWorkTrackingConnector lists none; CsvWorkTrackingConnector declares IFeatureSource itself. Jira and Azure DevOps connector classes are unchanged; Program.cs registrations unchanged.
